descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S28 「断言和预期 4 相反的现成 spec：'dose changes and resumes are visible in the medication tracker after reload'」 Existing spec that asserts the opposite of ER 4: 'dose changes and resumes are visible in the medication tracker after reload'

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U7 A dose change renames the row to the new dose and keeps its history (the old dose stays readable on the row).（UAT TC-19 ER 4；TFA-92597 R7）
  • U13 A repeat hold on a held drug changes nothing; a held or stopped row never resets to active unless a restart is dictated.（UAT TC-19 ER 9；TFA-92597 R5）
  • U5 A conditional or future order ('restart tomorrow if K is fine') never changes today's status.（UAT TC-19 ER 2；TFA-92597 R1）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Tim's chromium test in e2e/medication-detection.spec.ts: Hospital patient with Furosemide 80 mg IV active, Eliquis 5 mg held 'Held for procedure' and Amlodipine 5 mg; the model answered at the socket with a decrease and a resume

When Save & Extract 'Decrease furosemide from 80 mg to 40 mg. Resume apixaban this evening.', then reload

Then Per UAT ER 4 / TFA-92597 R7 the furosemide row should be renamed to 40 mg with 80 kept as history. Whether 'Resume apixaban this evening' may make Eliquis active today is Q19

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Read inverted: the test finds the furosemide row by its old exact name 'Furosemide 80 mg IV' (Changed), so a green result means the row was NOT renamed: evidence against U7 on Save & Extract, never a Pass of U7. When R7 is fixed on the event path this lookup is expected to go red and the test must change with the fix (Q18). …

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S28 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-19.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。
